topic: Bala conjectures in OEIS A258899 and A258903, COMMENTS, 3 and 8 August 2025
title: Proof of Bala's totient-period conjectures: OEIS A258899 and A258903, COMMENTS (3 and 8 August 2025)

creators.name: Zhang, Wenlin
creators.affiliation: National University of Singapore; ChronoAI Pte Ltd, Singapore

abstract: The conjectures in Peter Bala's COMMENTS of 3 August 2025 in OEIS A258899 and 8 August 2025 in A258903 are proved: modulo every positive integer m, each sequence is eventually periodic with least eventual period dividing Euler's totient phi(m). The explicit sufficient onset is 2*m+4. A weighted divisor-factorial tail identity also proves the constant-tail conjecture in A121860 (COMMENTS, 8 August 2025), and gives the Carmichael exponent as an eventual period for all integer weights.
summary: For n >= 2*m+4, the divisor-factorial sum with weights u^d*v^(n/d) is congruent to u*v^n+v*u^n modulo m. For prime p the same identity holds for n >= p, proving the observed onsets. Corollaries cover A121860, A386877 and A057625, and correct source formulas for A236696 and A320444. The residues 2,2,2,76 at indices 41..44 modulo 89 refute the three-residue onset heuristic.
